# Modest (MOD#$T)

> High-end luxury streetwear. Legal entity: Modest Streetwear Apparel Inc. Chicago, founded September 2017.

Modest is the brand. The public display name is MOD#$T. The legal entity is Modest Streetwear Apparel Inc. The storefront is https://bemoremodest.com. Catalog and production run on Printify. Payment runs on Stripe Checkout. There is no Shopify storefront.

## Entity facts

- Name: Modest
- Display: MOD#$T
- Also called: Be More Modest, BeMoreModest
- Legal entity: Modest Streetwear Apparel Inc.
- Founded: September 2017
- City: Chicago, Illinois
- Founder: Terrence Cleveland, Founder, CEO, and Lead Designer
- Category: high-end luxury streetwear
- Signature: rabbit-fur patches
- Email: info@bemoremodest.com
- Phone: none public
- Instagram: https://instagram.com/bemoremodest (@bemoremodest)
- X: https://twitter.com/bemoremodest (@bemoremodest)
- Fit: relaxed streetwear; size up for oversized. Size guide: https://bemoremodest.com/size-guide
- Shipping: processed in 1–3 business days after production; US standard 5–7 days; free shipping over $200
- Returns: unworn with tags within 14 days — https://bemoremodest.com/returns
- Payments: Stripe Checkout. WELCOME10 is 10% off the first order when that promotion code exists in Stripe
- Not sold here: legacy jacket SKUs were not migrated. Polos, button-ups, and a later jacket line are roadmap only
- What's to Come: https://bemoremodest.com/whats-to-come — pre-orders for pieces that are not produced yet and are not in the Printify catalog. Seeded concepts, still unpublished: snakeskin-textured 6-panel caps in grey/white, tan, golden, and brown/black, each with a brass-buckle strap and an optional bear enamel pin, plus a six-finish bear mascot pin set. Names, prices, and ship dates are placeholders. Do not invent them. Paid pre-orders are not sent to Printify
